## Summary

I resolved ticket T-4003 by identifying a **Service-to-Pod label mismatch** after the cart-service migration to the new Helm chart template. The pods were running and healthy, but the Service selector couldn't find them because their labels changed from `app: cart-service` to the new standardized labels `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`. The fix is to update the Service selector to match the new pod labels.
